_comment: Layout for 'Shabour_Winelist' -- a multi-page categorized price list (category > region/country > wine+price). Font CHOICES match the original Shabour_Winelist_28.11.indd design (confirmed directly by the restaurant against the real InDesign file, not guessed). IMPORTANT: the category/subgroup roles carry different real-world meaning on different pages, so their fonts differ per page via layout_overrides -- on every page EXCEPT 'Vins au Verre', category=country (SHABOUR Semibold, rasterised, matching e.g. 'ISRAEL' in the original) and subgroup=sub-region (Avenir Next LT Pro Bold, matching e.g. 'Galilee'/'Haute Judee'). On the 'Vins au Verre' overview page specifically, category=wine style (Champagne/Blanc/Rose/Rouge, confirmed Avenir Next LT Pro Bold) and subgroup=country (SHABOUR Semibold) -- the reverse -- via that page's own layout_overrides.fonts. Page title also uses SHABOUR Semibold. Wine+price lines use a classic serif (reportlab's built-in Times-Roman, no file needed). Sizes/gaps are nudged up from the pre-existing values but deliberately capped short of the original render's true scale -- going further pushes 4 of the 12 pages onto an extra '(suite)' page, which is not acceptable (this document must stay exactly 12 pages, matching the printed original 1:1). These are the largest sizes that still fit all 12 logical pages with zero overflow. A page too long to fit still spills onto an automatic '(suite)' continuation page if content is later added, rather than shrinking.
